entities.name: Moliq
entities.description: Kor soldier and shieldmate from Zendikar, formerly an architect and civic leader of a community in the Makindi Trenches.

entities.name: Makindi Trenches
entities.description: Near-vertical crags where Moliq's community stood.

entities.name: World Queller
entities.description: Avatar of retribution that devastated Moliq's community.

events.summary: A World Queller, enraged at the community's audacity, wreaks havoc on Moliq's outpost and kills hundreds.
Moliq becomes a shieldmate devoted to protecting the party's mages and scholars.
events.quote: Since then he became a shieldmate

relations.note: The World Queller destroyed his community.
relations.quote: an avatar of retribution - a World Queller - enraged at the audacity of his fledgling community
